description:
What do you do when you are given a second chance at your life? That's what happened to Jigeon, the top actor in South Korea who fell down the stairs due to a clash with Lee Rowoon, the producer of the variety show he was going to star in. The accident caused Jigeon's life to be lost while Rowoon survived. However, Jigeon gets a second chance to come back to life on the condition that she get Rowoon's necklace within a week and in return, Rowoon who must die. What will Jigeon do to get Rowoon's necklace? Would Rowoon want to give the necklace to Jigeon? In the end, who will live between the two of them?

**Original Webtoon:**
